send_to_device: send a PyTorch tensor or nested data structure to a specified device like GPU or CPU
extract_model_from_parallel: extract the original model from a DataParallel or FSDP wrapper for inference or saving
patch_environment: temporarily set environment variables within a context block and restore them on exit
concatenate: concatenate multiple batches of tensors, dicts, or tuples along a specified dimension
pad_input_tensors: pad input tensors so their batch size is divisible by the number of processes
